_comment: Original DamageSourceThaumcraft.taint: setDamageBypassesArmor() + setMagicDamage() (TC4). 21.1.259's DamageEffects has no magic profile (removed in 1.21), so the type carries the plain hurt profile and the two flags are expressed by damage-type tags: this type is named in data/minecraft/tags/damage_type/bypasses_armor.json (the setDamageBypassesArmor() half) and in data/neoforge/tags/damage_type/is_magic.json (the setMagicDamage() half). Nothing applies either bypass at an emitter. msgId 'thaumcraft.taint' makes 1.21.1 resolve the death.attack.thaumcraft.taint lang keys, which ship the original death.attack.taint[.player] strings. Exhaustion 0.1 is the vanilla multiplier. Registered now so taint damage and its death message resolve.
